fields.description: Club Place is an apartment development beside the golf-course neighbourhood of Dubai Hills Estate. One to three bedroom homes include ground-floor options with larger terraces, while shared facilities occupy landscaped podium and upper-level spaces. The setting looks towards fairways and low-rise communities, with the exact outlook depending on the building, floor and orientation.

overview: The brochure emphasises natural light, balconies and clean-lined interiors, with the surrounding golf landscape informing the setting. It describes energy-conscious design but does not supply a verified certification or a quantified saving. The launch sheet adds a residents’ lounge and a neutral finish palette. Apartment plans vary by building, so comparisons should consider the suite and outdoor areas separately rather than relying on bedroom count alone.
research.locationNote: Club Place sits in Dubai Hills Estate near the golf-course villas. Dubai Hills Mall, the park and King’s College Hospital are district destinations, with access through Al Khail Road and Umm Suqeim Street. Golf membership and guaranteed travel times are not established as purchase inclusions.
research.priceNote: On review, Emaar’s displayed selection starts at AED 2,852,888, while the same page retains a historic AED 1.45m launch headline. The July 2024 fact sheet lists launch starts of AED 1.45m, AED 2.23m and AED 3.4m for one, two and three bedrooms. Confirm current unit availability and terms.
research.paymentNote: The dated launch plan totals 80% before completion, including 10% on booking, and 20% on completion. Later releases or resales can have different outstanding instalments; obtain the selected unit’s schedule.
research.handoverNote: December 2028 is the estimated completion in the launch payment document and Property Finder. Confirm the contractual delivery date and current construction position.

facts.label: Published residence mix
facts.value: The launch sheet lists 234 one-bedroom, 164 two-bedroom and 75 three-bedroom apartments, totalling 473 homes. This does not describe current stock.

facts.label: Ground-floor outdoor space
facts.value: Building B two-bedroom BG04 totals 1,571.96 sq ft: a 1,007.39 sq ft suite and 564.57 sq ft of outdoor area. Building A three-bedroom AG01 totals 1,931.37 sq ft and includes a maid’s room, powder room and long terrace.

facts.label: Availability needs confirmation
facts.value: Property Finder labels the launch sold out, while Emaar displays a priced selection. Neither establishes availability for a specific buyer; ask for a current unit confirmation.
